dism.note: Included with supported Windows; no separate installer.

sfc.note: Included with supported Windows; no separate installer.

windows-recovery.note: Included with supported Windows; no separate installer.

winsat.note: Included with supported Windows; no separate installer.

robocopy.note: Included with supported Windows; no separate installer.

pktmon.note: Included with supported Windows; no separate installer.

primary.label: Get Quick Assist in Microsoft Store

chatgpt.note: Sign in to use the service; desktop and mobile options are available separately.

chrome-remote-desktop.note: The support workflow supplies the host setup and session approval; Google sign-in may be required.

oem-drivers.note: Choose the device manufacturer, exact model and operating system before downloading firmware or drivers.

powershell.note: The primary ZIP is modern PowerShell. Use the built-in Windows PowerShell action when a repair procedure specifically requires the Windows shell.

gemini-cli.note: This is the published CLI bundle; follow the documented runtime, installation and authentication requirements.

safety-scanner.note: Download a fresh copy for each job; the scanner expires after ten days.

wiztree.note: Free personal use; business service work requires the appropriate commercial license.

wizfile.note: Free personal use; business service work requires the appropriate commercial license.

primary.label: Get x64 live ISO · download page

gparted.note: The publisher route selects the exact ISO through SourceForge. Mirror links are generated during download; no expiring mirror URL is stored.

angry-ip-scanner.note: Requires the Java runtime version documented by the project.

get-help.note: The instructions provide Windows app launch buttons. Choose the matching problem; classic Outlook diagnostics are separate from new Outlook.

primary.label: Download x64 Xfce live image · ISO

microsoft-windows11-media.note: The media tool creates installation media. Use the official options page for language-specific ISO selection; those ISO links can expire.

windows-performance-toolkit.note: The ADK setup installs selected components; choose Windows Performance Toolkit. Check the supported Windows version before installation.

tcpdump.note: Upstream publishes source here. Use a supported operating-system package for a ready-to-run installation, or follow the upstream build instructions.

rsync.note: Upstream publishes source here. Use a supported operating-system package for a ready-to-run installation, or follow the upstream build instructions.

photorec.note: PhotoRec and QPhotoRec are included in the official TestDisk archive; save recovered files to another drive.

openssh.note: Windows offers OpenSSH as an optional feature; enable only the client or server role required for the job.

malwarebytes.note: The Windows bootstrapper downloads the selected edition. Other platforms remain available from All downloads / setup.

hitmanpro.note: These are the exact publisher file routes. Sophos applies an export check before delivery; the automated request reached that check rather than a file. Use All downloads / setup if it does not continue.

screenconnect.note: For remote help, open the session link supplied by your technician. A managed access installer is generated inside your organisation’s ScreenConnect site; there is no universal client file. The public server installer is a different product role.

crystaldiskinfo.note: This opens the exact Standard Edition ZIP on the publisher’s file host and starts its download. The host generates expiring mirror URLs, so a temporary signed address is not saved here.

anydesk.note: A commercial license is required for professional use; the download alone does not provide that license.

teamviewer.note: The full client provides support; QuickSupport is for receiving attended support. Professional use requires the appropriate TeamViewer license.

tailscale.note: Choose the installer for the machine architecture, then sign in to the approved tailnet. Check the organization plan and access policy before use.

hwinfo.note: Check the HWiNFO commercial-use terms for customer work; free personal availability does not establish a technician-use license.

everything.note: These links are for the stable Everything desktop application, not the separately licensed Everything Server product.

occt.note: Commercial technician work requires the appropriate Pro or Enterprise license. The Personal edition is not the free business-use route; Pro downloads require sign-in.

winscp.note: The publisher generates expiring CDN URLs. The stable official download page obtains a fresh file link; no expiring URL is embedded.

bitdefender-gravityzone.note: A licensed business administrator creates and deploys the endpoint package through GravityZone Control Center; consumer Bitdefender Central is a separate service.

defender-business.note: Follow the licensed organization’s onboarding method. Windows protection is integrated; organizational onboarding packages and other-platform clients depend on the deployment.

sophos-endpoint.note: Sign in to the licensed organization to generate the endpoint installer. Linux server protection has separate deployment and subscription requirements.

primary.label: Sign in for the Windows download

veeam-agent.note: The publisher download route requires a Veeam account; no temporary authenticated file URL is stored.

meshcentral.note: Install and configure the server with the documented Node.js package. Generate endpoint agents from your own server so they connect to the correct organization.

dislocker.note: The upstream project documents a source build for supported Unix-like systems; this is not a ready Windows application.

primary.label: Get Windows portable ZIP · download page

system-informer.note: The exact publisher-hosted ZIP page obtains the file through a mirror; temporary mirror URLs are not saved.

ddrescue.note: This is source code. For an immediately bootable recovery environment, use the SystemRescue ISO in the failing-drive guide; keep the mapfile and image on healthy storage.

iperf3.note: Upstream publishes source. Install a supported operating-system package or follow its build instructions; this link is not an official Windows executable.

cryptsetup.note: Install your distribution’s maintained package for normal use; this upstream source archive requires a build.

sigma.note: This archive contains detection rules, not an antivirus executable. Convert and tune rules for the target telemetry platform.

claude-code.note: These are installer scripts. Review the documented prerequisites and authentication options before running a downloaded script.

wazuh.note: This installs the endpoint agent, not the complete monitoring platform. Configure it for your deployed server and follow the documented enrollment steps.

clonezilla.note: This is the publisher’s exact ISO route. The file host may show its download page before delivering the image; mirror delivery varies by client. No expiring mirror URL is stored.
